- **#8841, please confirm**: West yard Door 2 double-books when flatbeds check in early. It comes from your own message in #central-random on 13 Oct, but that thread only calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. The digest calls Marrow Fieldworks "Pree's dealer account" before the 5 Jan handoff, so it's probably the same account, but nothing says so outright.

I left out FR-882 because it's a feature request from Marrow Agrisupply, which is a different account. Moss's Central cheat sheet has a Marrow Agrisupply line too, but no ticket number.

I checked every Moss digest you can see and all of #central-random, and found no other Marrow Fieldworks tickets.
